about: The Ancient Relay (Grok Bot's Rodin mesh, stairs re-sloped to 20 degrees, collision added). Unreal cm, site-relative; the site pivot is the mesh pivot: on the ground at the centre of the base. +X is the front (stairs, and the ring's face). One actor, no separate pieces.

pieces.name: Relay
pieces.note: Material slot 0: scalar RelayPower scales the emissive (core, beams, runes). Dormant 0.15 (MI_Relay), awake 1.0 (MI_Relay_Awake). To wake it in play: CreateDynamicMaterialInstance(0) on the mesh component, then SetScalarParameterValue("RelayPower", 0.15 -> 1.0) over the wake beat. GlowStrength 10 and GlowColor white are the other emissive knobs.

wake_interact.note: The pilot stands on the court in front of the ring, looking along -X at the core (core about 340 cm away and 360 cm up). The ring and its lower cross arm start at X = -67 / -78: 217 cm of clear court in front of the wake point. No socket: use the numbers.

walk_path_site_cm.what: ground in front of the stairs (collision toe at X = 773, visual toe at X = 728)
on the flight (nosings at 19.3 degrees; collision over the treads)
on the carved 20 degree slope that was the 46 cm top riser
the landing (11 cm step down to the court behind it)

stairs.riser_as_delivered: 46 cm at the top (a capsule snag), then 9 cm risers at 23.6 degrees

placement_rules: Put the site pivot ON the ground. There are no piles: the plinth bottom is flat at Z = 0, so place it on ground flat within about 20 cm across its 11 m footprint.
Keep 3 m of flat ground in front of the stair toe (site X 773 to 1073, Y -195 to 5).
Yaw it freely; never scale it (the stairs are sized for the 180 cm pilot).
